title: SLA-Aware Task Offloading in the IoT Edge-Cloud Continuum: Class-Weighted Deep Reinforcement Learning Against an Exact Optimum
abstract: arXiv:2611.10638v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to decide where Internet of Things (IoT) tasks with different latency limits run in the edge-cloud continuum, yet some methods give every missed task the same penalty and few compare their agents with an optimal policy. This benchmark study builds four offloading systems small enough to solve exactly by dynamic programming and measures reward and learner against the optimum. A bonus for a met limit makes each miss cost its penalty plus the bonus, which shifts the class weights of published per-class rewards. A class-blind penalty stays 65% to 118% above the optimal cost even with a perfect learner, while a corrected per-class penalty comes within 0.13% of the optimum. With a per-class reward, tuned proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents come within 9% to 11% of the optimum in the smallest system, and the corrected one beats a tuned reservation rule in 9 of 10 seeds. translated_title: 物联网边云连续体中面向SLA的任务卸载：以精确最优解为基准的类别加权深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（RL）常被用于决定具有不同延迟限制的物联网（IoT）任务在边云连续体中的运行位置，然而一些方法对每个未按时完成的任务施加相同的惩罚，且很少有研究将训练出的智能体与最优策略进行比较。本基准研究构建了四个规模小到可通过动态规划精确求解的任务卸载系统，并将奖励设计与学习器性能对照最优解进行衡量。为满足延迟限制的任务设置奖金，会使每次错失任务的成本变为惩罚加奖金之和，从而改变了已发表的按类别奖励方案中的类别权重。研究发现：即使在完美学习器的情况下，类别盲（class-blind）惩罚的成本仍比最优成本高出65%至118%，而修正后的按类别惩罚则与最优解相差不超过0.13%。在使用按类别奖励时，经过调优的近端策略优化（PPO）智能体在最小系统中的表现与最优解相差9%至11%，且修正后的方法在10个随机种子中有9个击败了调优后的预留规则。在更大的系统中……
tldr: 该研究通过四个可精确求解的基准系统证明：在物联网边云任务卸载中，类别盲的惩罚设计即使配合完美学习器也会导致成本高出最优解65%-118%，而修正后的按SLA类别加权的奖励设计可使PPO智能体性能逼近精确最优解。
en_tdlr: Using four exactly solvable benchmark systems, this study shows that class-blind penalties keep costs 65%-118% above optimum even with a perfect learner, while a corrected SLA class-weighted reward design brings tuned PPO agents within 9%-11% of the exact optimum in IoT edge-cloud task offloading.
